## About
Alamo Ranch Animal Hospital is a veterinary hospital on Alamo Parkway in San Antonio. We care for pets through wellness visits and vaccinations, puppy and kitten care, senior wellness, lab work, and radiology and ultrasound.
We welcome new clients, and we would love to talk with you about your pet's care. Pet owners have given us a 4.5 rating across 353 Google reviews.
Reviewers mention Dr Shannon and Dr. Greg by name. They talk about a clean, welcoming office and a team that takes its time with shy pets and first-time owners.

## Services
- General Wellness/Vaccinations: Regular check ups and vaccines to help keep your pet healthy.
- Puppy and Kitten Wellness: Early care for young pets, with time to go over their vaccine and care schedule with you.
- Senior Wellness: Care for pets in their later years.
- Laboratory Diagnostics: Lab testing, such as bloodwork, to help us understand what is going on with your pet.
- Radiology/Ultrasound: Imaging, including x-rays, to help us look more closely when your pet isn't feeling well.

## FAQ
Q: Are you taking new clients?
A: Yes. We welcome all new clients to our veterinary facility, and we would love to discuss your pet's care.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. You can schedule your appointment online, or call us at (210) 538-7484.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will you remind me when vaccines are due?
A: One reviewer mentioned getting friendly reminders about vaccines and other medical procedures.
